<?php
function short_hook_value29(int $value): int {
    echo "G", $value, "|";
    return $value + 1;
}
class HookExpression29 {
    public int $value = 7 {
        get => short_hook_value29($this->value);
    }
}
$box = new HookExpression29();
echo $box->value, "|", $box->value, "|";
$box->value = 17;
echo $box->value, "|";

<?php
class HookExpressionType29 {
    public int $value = 7 {
        get => $this->value === 7 ? [] : 17;
    }
}
$box = new HookExpressionType29();
try { echo "before|", $box->value, "|after|"; }
catch (\TypeError $error) {
    echo "caught|", $error->getMessage(), "|", $error->getTraceAsString(), "|";
}
$box->value = 17;
echo "resume|", $box->value, "|";

<?php
class HookExpressionUntyped29 {
    public $value = 7 {
        get => $this->value + 1;
    }
}
$box = new HookExpressionUntyped29();
echo $box->value, "|";
$box->value = 17;
echo $box->value, "|";

<?php
function expression_reread29($box, int $backing): int {
    echo "H", $backing, "|";
    if ($backing === 7) {
        $box->value = 17;
        return $box->value;
    }
    return $backing;
}
class HookExpressionNested29 {
    public int $value = 7 {
        get => expression_reread29($this, $this->value);
    }
}
$box = new HookExpressionNested29();
echo $box->value, "|";

<?php
class HookExpressionStringValue29 {
    function __toString(): string { echo "S|"; return "19"; }
}
function expression_string29(string $backing): HookExpressionStringValue29 {
    echo "G", $backing, "|";
    return new HookExpressionStringValue29();
}
class HookExpressionString29 {
    public string $value = "7" {
        get => expression_string29($this->value);
    }
}
$box = new HookExpressionString29();
echo $box->value, "|";

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);
class HookExpressionStrict29 {
    public int $value = 7 {
        get =>
            $this->value === 7
                ? "19"
                : 17;
    }
}
$box = new HookExpressionStrict29();
try { echo "before|", $box->value, "|after|"; }
catch (\TypeError $error) {
    echo "caught|", $error->getMessage(), "|", $error->getLine(), "|", $error->getTraceAsString(), "|";
}
$box->value = 17;
echo "resume|", $box->value, "|";

<?php
class HookExpressionLeaf29 {
    function __destruct() { echo "D|"; }
}
function expression_leaf29(HookExpressionLeaf29 $leaf): HookExpressionLeaf29 {
    echo "G|";
    unset($GLOBALS["box"]);
    return $leaf;
}
class HookExpressionHeap29 {
    public HookExpressionLeaf29 $value {
        get => expression_leaf29($this->value);
    }
    function __construct(HookExpressionLeaf29 $leaf) { $this->value = $leaf; }
    function __destruct() { echo "B|"; }
}
$leaf = new HookExpressionLeaf29();
$weak = \WeakReference::create($leaf);
$box = new HookExpressionHeap29($leaf);
unset($leaf);
$result = $box->value;
echo $weak->get() === null ? "N|" : "L|";
unset($result);
echo $weak->get() === null ? "N|" : "L|";

    }
}
